e_voltage_table.label: CORRECTED category error
e_voltage_table.superseded: the table equated the controller's 700 V transient node limit with a MOSFET required rating (implying '700 V requires 800 V device'), and separately implied a higher-voltage MOSFET protects the controller
e_voltage_table.correct: the MOSFET's required rating follows from the surge-clamped TERMINAL voltage it must block; the controller's node stress follows from the same terminal voltages compared against its OWN 440 V operating / 700 V transient limits; neither dictates the other

bootstrap_operating_corners.method: HS: VGS = (VCC - Vd(bs)) - Qg(VGS)/Cbs - (II(VCCHL) + IGSS)*T_on/Cbs solved self-consistently. LS: VGS = VCC - (2*Qg + I_bias*T_on)/CVCC. T_on = 8.333 ms (one 60 Hz conduction half-cycle).
bootstrap_operating_corners.unbounded_term: the reverse leakage of the internal bootstrap diode while it blocks the line (V_node - VCC up to ~176 V) is not specified in the captured TEA2209T datasheet; it would add to the discharge of Cbs and is not bounded

worst_case_gate_voltage.basis: VCC >= 10.2 V, Vd(bs) <= 1.3 V, II(VCCHL) <= 12 uA are guaranteed maxima; Qg is TYPICAL, so the value is a CONDITIONAL worst case, NOT a guaranteed bound
worst_case_gate_voltage.status: CONDITIONAL - typical Qg cannot support a worst-case bound
worst_case_gate_voltage.bound_only_what_can_be_bounded: with 220 nF the guaranteed leakage droop is <= 0.455 V; Vd <= 1.3 V; VCC >= 10.2 V. The Qg/Cbs droop is a typical-data estimate and is what remains unbounded.

bootstrap_operating_corners.justification: 220 nF is at the top of NXP's own Sec 12 range (100-220 nF) and is essentially its Figure 3/5 typical value (200 nF). Versus 100 nF it cuts the guaranteed leakage droop from 1.000 V to 0.455 V and lifts the typical-Qg conditional worst case from 6.305 V to 7.592 V, which is above the ~7 V near-full-enhancement knee of Diagram 7 (3.0% vs 1.4% Rds penalty). The recharge cost is negligible (RC << 1 ms in an 8.33 ms half-cycle). This is a ROBUSTNESS choice, not a proof that 100 nF fails: from typical Qg it takes ~2.2x Qg to reach the 5.0 V floating UVLO with 100 nF and ~5.8x with 220 nF, because Qg has no published maximum. The datasheet's own warning against low bootstrap values (Sec 12) plus NXP's own 200 nF configuration is the basis for choosing the top of the range.

charge_discharge_leakage.charge: bootstrap diode from VCC during the off half-cycle (8.33 ms); full recharge assumed; not the binding constraint
charge_discharge_leakage.discharge: Qg(VGS) at turn-on + II(VCCHL)*T_on + IGSS*T_on + unspecified diode reverse leakage
charge_discharge_leakage.leakage: II(VCCHL) 4/7/12 uA at VL=200 V is the dominant bounded term; IGSS 100 nA is negligible

per_point_rds.method: Rds(Tj, VGS) = Rds10(Tj) * [Rds(VGS)/Rds(10 V)]; Rds10(Tj) from digitised Diagram 8, ratio from digitised Diagram 7 at ID=30 A, Tj=125 C
per_point_rds.assumption: the VGS correction ratio is temperature-independent over the 45-51 C computed range (Diagram 7 is published only at 125 C) - ASSUMED, not derived

id_current_sensitivity_ratio.note: ratio spread across the digitised ID columns; the 5-stroke ID=21/15 rows are the fragile ones (merged curves), so ID=30 was primary

terminal_voltages.surge_without_mov: INDETERMINATE - surge source impedance and bus clamp not captured

mosfet_required_rating.statement: REQUIRED rating follows from the surge-clamped terminal voltage the off device blocks (~400 V assumed with the L-N MOV), not from the controller's 700 V node limit

controller_node_stresses.statement: the controller's L/R/VR nodes are set by the circuit (the same MOV clamp), NOT by the MOSFET rating; the controller's own 700 V transient allowance does not require an 800/1000 V device, and a 1000 V MOSFET does not lower the node voltage
controller_node_stresses.line_to_pe_common_mode: INDETERMINATE - not clamped by the L-N MOV; depends on the Y-cap / PE / dc-return network, not captured

savings_step6.residual_uncertainty: P_saved is an upper-side estimate: recovery (43 mW sensitivity), inrush and EMI losses are unknown and NOT subtracted. The device-parameter basis is typical; the 98% row shows the spread and the guaranteed 25 C max is 0.017 ohm. The voltage-rating condition (MOV clamp assumed) gates the whole result.
